//ClientIds: The client ID of every client the IDP registers. The SAME value must appear in the component that uses it: its Oidc:ClientId (web BFFs and the Shell), its <Worker>:ClientId (Kafka subscribers), PARTNER_PRODUCTS_WORKER_CLIENT_ID / the Node services' runnow.bat or .env, and ClientIds:<same key> in every API that pins it. Each secret is ClientSecrets:<client ID> (appsettings.Development.json).
//ClientBaseUrls: The https address of each web client; its redirect, logout and back-channel URIs are built from it. Must equal the address the client listens on (its launchSettings.json / .env), the Shell's MfeOrigins entry, and - for Shell - ShellOrigin in the Shell and every MFE BFF.
//ClientKeys: private_key_jwt clients (the customers' channel): the file holding each client's PUBLIC key as a JWK (ClientKeys:<client id>; environment variables are expanded). Made by ps/pki/New-EwpLocalPki.ps1; the private key stays with the client. A missing or private key file stops the start-up. Set per environment (appsettings.Development.json locally).
//CustomerSignIn: The customers' own sign-in (My EWP). CustomerOnboardingApiBaseUrl: the Customer Onboarding API (https), asked during an online registration - must equal that API's address (its launchSettings.json). ShowCodesOnPage: Development only - the one-time code on the page in place of an SMS.
//Mfa: Two-step sign-in with Google Authenticator. Off by default; true = every user enrols at the next sign-in, then enters a code each time.
